## All the apps you need, stitched together in one workspace

### Mail App

Easily send, receive, and manage your mail in one place. Stitch mail to events in your calendar or important files — never miss anything important.

### Calendar App

Schedule meetings, set reminders, and view your entire agenda at a glance. Keep track of meeting notes, the latest version of files, or attendees with Stitching.

### Notes App [...] ### Slides App

Build and present decks without leaving your workspace — your notes, files, and meetings are right there when you need them.

## The hidden cost of switching between apps

Many productivity tools add to the noise of endless open windows, tabs, and apps — from email, calendar, notes, and files, finding new information requires constant hopping to complete simple tasks.

With Stitch.ai, you can work in context, in one place. Stitching files, events, and notes together as you go. No more searching for that thing you can’t remember the name of. Stitch.ai will keep track of your work for you.

ClickUp Logo

ClickUp

ClickUp operates as a productivity software company. It offers an artificial intelligence (AI) workspace for project management, team communication, and collaboration. The company provides tools including task management and time tracking. ClickUp serves various sectors requiring project and task management solutions. It was founded in 2016 and is based in San Diego, California.

Stitch.ai Logo

Stitch.ai

Stitch.ai is a productivity tool designed to manage workflows in various business sectors. The platform provides a solution for managing emails, tasks, notes, calendars, contacts, and files. Stitch.ai serves professionals and teams looking for a workspace to aid collaboration and efficiency. It was founded in 2024 and is based in California, United States.
